Name: Hadarezer, King of Zobah
Summary: King of Zobah whom David smote unto Hamath as he went to establish his dominion by the Euphrates.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 18:3: King of Zobah whom David smote unto Hamath as he went to establish his dominion by the Euphrates.
LifeLesson: The mention of Hadarezer in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
